decision_maker.policy: the LLM only sees column names, local column statistics (min/p05/median/p95/max) and aggregate losses, never a patient row; gradients, aggregation, masking and DP are deterministic code

meta.honesty: Real default-of-credit-card-clients records (1200 of 30000) split into three SIMULATED banks; the player replays this recorded run, not live networking. Masking, DP noise, the agents' decisions and every number are real outputs of the code. DP accounting is a stated-ε demonstration, not an audited accountant.
